title: Murasu: orange alert in Khammam, Nalgonda and 4 more Telangana districts today
body: IMD has an orange alert today in six Telangana districts as Cyclone Murasu nears. Landfall is likely near Ongole, AP, on Tuesday morning at 100–110 kmph. Hyderabad is not on the orange list.
means: Orange districts: Khammam, Mahabubnagar, Nalgonda, Suryapet, Nagarkurnool, Wanaparthy
Travelling to coastal AP Nov 2–3? Check train and bus status
Farmers: cover harvested paddy with tarpaulins
care: Check your district's IMD warning before travelling today.
